# elempleo fixtures

Captured 2026-10-22 from the public elempleo Colombia site. Public job listings only; no account, CV or personal
data is included.

## listing.html

Source: `https://www.elempleo.com/co/ofertas-empleo/trabajo-analista-de-datos` — the listing for the query
`analista de datos` in Colombia. 20 offer cards plus the board's client-side template row (`{{title}}`).

## detail.html

Source: `https://www.elempleo.com/co/ofertas-trabajo/data-analyst-specialist-1886762160` — the offer behind the
first card of `listing.html`. Carries a JSON-LD `JobPosting` whose `datePosted` is written `2026-9-4`.
